item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. It will transform generation, storage, transmission, and efficiency—replacing scarcity with abundance on a global scale.

2. Superintelligent AI will unlock energy breakthroughs at a speed humanity has never seen. If it arrives within 20 years, nearly free energy will follow—reshaping transportation, food, housing, industry, and everyday life worldwide.

3. If we build superintelligent AI in the next 20 years, the age of expensive energy will end. Better grids, batteries, solar cells, reactors, and new technologies will drive costs toward zero and make abundant energy available around the world.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe the arrival of superintelligent AI within the next 20 years will make energy nearly free worldwide. Systems far more capable than today’s best minds will accelerate breakthroughs in generation, storage, transmission, and efficiency at a pace no human research effort can match. They will design better solar cells, batteries, grids, reactors, and entirely new technologies, while automating the work needed to build and operate them. Scarcity will give way to abundance as costs collapse across countries and continents. That transformation will reshape industry, transportation, food, housing, and daily life. We are preparing for a world where access to abundant energy is no longer a privilege, but a global reality.
